This is a gap between the recipe SKILL.md ('list it explicitly in the result envelope's files[]') and the validator's actual strictness -- reported here as a fourth pipeline-tooling defect found during this rule's execution, alongside the three already on record (verify_shard.py cannot verify deletion shards, the gitignored jade.mf gap in workspace copies, register_recipe.py's stale BUCKETS/CLI). The actual build.xml / build.properties / BootProfileImpl.java diffs are in the git history of this shard's commit(s) on work/jump-811.

A second, unrelated pre-existing defect surfaced only once CORBA_REMOVAL cleared javac's default 100-error cap: every migration-run workspace's src/jade/lib/commons-codec/ directory has always been missing the actual commons-codec-1.3.jar (the *.jar gitignore rule strips it from every workspace copy, same root cause as the already-documented jade.mf gap), so jade.lang.acl.StringACLCodec, jade.mtp.http.XMLCodec, jade.content.onto.SerializableOntology, and jade.domain.DFDBKB all failed with 'cannot find symbol: variable Base64' once org.omg errors stopped eating the whole error budget first. Fixed by copying the vendored jar from the read-only JADE-4.6.0 baseline (which does have it on disk, gitignored) into this workspace's lib/commons-codec/ -- not a CORBA_REMOVAL change, but required to reach a real BUILD SUCCESSFUL and reported here for visibility.
